charges.label: Weight component
charges.quote: a weight component of ₹6.00 per kg of billed weight

charges.label: Distance component
charges.quote: a distance component of ₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance

charges.label: Cold chain premium (20% of freight charge)
charges.quote: Consignments booked as cold chain travel in refrigerated vehicles and carry a premium of 20% on the freight charge (the sum of the weight and distance components).

document_rules.rule: The Carrier invoices as trips are pooled, typically fortnightly; payment is due 21 days from invoice date.
The c-note number quoted on each invoice line must correspond to a Customer booking; lines that cannot be matched to a booking are not payable until reconciled.
The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices.
A credit note must reference the original c-note number and the invoice it corrects, and must cover the full corrected amount.

ambiguities.description: The agreement states only standard service is offered. No rate is defined for express service; a shipment recorded with service_level=express has no basis for pricing under this contract.

notes: Contract is minimal: freight = (weight_kg * 6) + (distance_km * 2), with a 20% cold-chain premium on that sum when special_handling contains cold_chain. No tiers, minimums, fragile/residential surcharges, or invoice-level discounts are mentioned. accessorials_policy.closed_list is set true because §1 defines freight per consignment as exactly the sum of the two named components and §3 is the only additional charge described; no other accessorial charges are contemplated anywhere in the text. Ambiguity: express service has no rate basis since §2 restricts the agreement to standard service only.
